cases.problem: The consultant kept publishing broad wellness advice that funded performance brands could not safely reuse.
cases.pursuit: He began pairing each idea with a named evidence source, a claim boundary, and one buyer-use case.
cases.payoff: The content became specific enough to demonstrate a claim-safe content service.
cases.want: Make his expertise legible to funded health and performance brands.
cases.obstacle: Generic posts hid the difference between his work and commodity content.
cases.turn: He treated evidence boundaries as part of the creative, not a compliance pass at the end.
cases.change: His posts became proof of method rather than disconnected advice.

cases.problem: A creator noticed that every weekly post felt like a performance.
cases.pursuit: She tracked which topics she would discuss without an audience and removed the rest for one month.
cases.payoff: She still has not found the final format, but she now knows the problem is topic ownership rather than discipline.
cases.want: Build a body of work she can sustain.
cases.obstacle: Her calendar rewarded output volume instead of genuine interest.
cases.turn: The month-long log separated low energy from low conviction.
cases.change: Her diagnosis changed, even though the journey remains open.

cases.problem: The publishing queue stopped after an expired credential.
cases.pursuit: The operator restored the credential and replayed the failed item.

cases.problem: A private family event changed how the teller thinks about ambition.
cases.pursuit: The teller rebuilt the weekly schedule around one explicitly supplied boundary.
cases.payoff: The new schedule protects the relationship without naming the event or the other person.
cases.want: Explain a change in work philosophy.
cases.obstacle: The triggering event and third-party details are withheld.
cases.turn: The teller chose a new boundary.
cases.change: The teller's own operating behavior changed.

cases.problem: The creator felt invisible despite posting every day.
cases.change: Engagement changed, but the causal path is unknown.
